description: Read-only API integration catalog for Studio OS and active projects.

providers.purpose: AI generation, analysis, embeddings, and assistant workflows when explicitly activated.
knownLimitations: Usage depends on model availability, rate limits, and configured billing.
providers.nextAction: Keep documented until a project explicitly requires OpenAI runtime integration.

providers.purpose: Repository, pull request, issue, and CI visibility for development delivery.
knownLimitations: Token scopes and organization policies determine accessible repositories.
providers.nextAction: List required scopes per project before adding any GitHub integration workflow.

providers.purpose: Messaging bot channel for alerts, publishing support, or client communication when needed.
knownLimitations: Bot permissions and chat access must be configured outside Studio OS.
providers.nextAction: Keep as catalog-only until a real Telegram bot use case is approved.

providers.purpose: Knowledge base, project documentation, and workspace context integration when activated.
knownLimitations: Workspace sharing controls decide which pages an integration can access.
providers.nextAction: Document target workspace and page boundaries before any Notion integration.

providers.purpose: Commerce marketplace data for NumberNinjaDesigns product and shop workflows.
knownLimitations: Marketplace APIs require app registration and OAuth authorization outside this catalog.
providers.nextAction: Define read-only shop visibility requirements before any Etsy integration.

providers.purpose: Content insights, trend research, and creator/search context for social content planning.
knownLimitations: Available endpoints and scopes depend on TikTok app review and product approval.
providers.nextAction: Keep cataloged until a specific TikTok insight workflow is scoped.

providers.purpose: Visual content planning, pins, boards, and brand discovery workflows when activated.
knownLimitations: Access depends on Pinterest app configuration and approved scopes.
providers.nextAction: Define read-only board and pin visibility needs before integration.

providers.purpose: Social content planning and performance context for brand channels.
knownLimitations: Business account and platform permissions determine available data.
providers.nextAction: Run the local Meta Social dry-run, then explicitly run a read-only sync after asset ownership and scopes are verified.

providers.purpose: Meta page, advertising, and social graph context for brand workflows when required.
knownLimitations: Meta permissions, app review, and asset ownership control access.
providers.nextAction: Run the local Meta Social dry-run, then explicitly run a read-only sync after Page ownership and scopes are verified.

providers.purpose: Deployment and hosting visibility for web projects when delivery workflows need it.
knownLimitations: Team, project, and token permissions determine visible deployments.
providers.nextAction: Use as catalog metadata only; do not add deployment automation in V1.3.
